Michele Cantwell-Copher is the Fresno County Superintendent of Schools in California. She assumed office on January 2, 2023. Her current term ends on January 4, 2027.
Cantwell-Copher ran for re-election for Fresno County Superintendent of Schools in California. She was on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
